intent.raw: How can we set an experiment to measure this? The U-curve has a real, citable shape (bias-variance / MDL) but no measured axis. 'SCU is the local minimum of entropy' remains a hypothesis, and 'SCU selection is the pre-translation control on E' is unfalsifiable until an entropy proxy is instrumented.
intent.objective: Refine, through the canonical ten-stage loop, a falsifiable, non-executed experiment design that instruments at least one translation-entropy proxy against work-unit size and tests whether the SCU sits at an interior minimum, producing an experiment-harness handoff without running a live experiment or editing the Craft definition.
intent.operator_sentence: Instrument an entropy proxy so the SCU U-curve becomes a measured, falsifiable claim instead of an asserted one.

route_menu.context_hint: More than one measurement profile could carry the experiment, so the design stage records a route decision over entropy proxies.

items.label: Tournament across all three proxies
items.description: Compare semantic-entropy dispersion, two-part MDL description length, and post-hoc residue rate under a pareto gate, then select or combine.

items.label: Single proxy: semantic-entropy dispersion
items.description: Instrument only self-consistency / semantic-entropy dispersion; most literal entropy but ignores the MDL minimizer that most directly yields a U-curve.

items.label: Single proxy: two-part description length (MDL)
items.description: Instrument only schema/context bits + residue/repair bits; gives an interior minimizer by construction but is the least literal as an 'entropy'.

technique_overlays.trigger: Every refine run preserves the canonical ordered loop with safe handoffs and observability.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each non-first stage consumes a prior handoff, stages keep owner boundaries, and trace events group by dispatch_id.

technique_overlays.trigger: Three candidate entropy proxies (semantic-entropy, MDL, residue-rate) and a competing rate-distortion hypothesis must be compared before a measurable axis is chosen.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The design stage declares proxy roles, a pareto/convergence criterion over measurability, cost, and falsifiability, and a recomposition proof back into the experiment plan.

technique_overlays.trigger: The selected proxy must survive a cheap controlled falsification before an expensive full sweep is planned.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: The repair stage runs a small pilot over a handful of units, names the expected U-shape, and names the failure interpretation if no interior minimum appears.

technique_overlays.trigger: The experiment builds directly on prior search residue (R1–R5) and rejected candidates from the entropy search session.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Prior residue and rejected proxies are cited by path and not silently re-derived or promoted.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Block if the Craft entropy definition or the search residue cannot be read.
Flag if the prior entropy session receipts are unavailable.

steps.name: Invoke Define the experiment objective
stop_conditions: Block if the define artifact cannot name a measurable entropy axis candidate.
Flag if the independent variable (unit size) is left implicit.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review of the define artifact
stop_conditions: Block if the define claims falsifiability without naming a failing condition.
Flag if entropy is conflated with residue without acknowledging the search card.

steps.name: Refine research decision
stop_conditions: Ask the operator before any external research pass.
Flag if a named external gap (e.g. a settled semantic-entropy estimator) is found and left unresolved.

steps.name: Distill the coherent measurable unit
convergence_criteria: The selected unit is one entropy proxy plus one unit-size variable that can be swept on a fixed corpus.
Rejected proxies are recorded with the reason they were not selected.
The selected unit has a recomposition path into a full experiment plan.
stop_conditions: Block if no proxy is independently measurable.
Flag if the selected unit cannot recompose into a sweep.

steps.name: Invoke Redefine / Design the experiment via proxy tournament
convergence_criteria: Each proxy role specifies its metric, estimator, cost, and the U-curve it predicts against unit size.
A pareto gate ranks proxies on measurability, cost, and falsifiability and records the rejected alternatives.
The winning design proves recomposition into a full unit-size sweep with a controlled corpus and a pre-registered prediction.
stop_conditions: Block if no proxy yields a pre-registerable, failable prediction.
Flag if the tournament collapses to one proxy without recording the comparison.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review of the experiment design
stop_conditions: Block if the design cannot fail (no falsification condition survives critique).
Flag if confounds between unit size and corpus difficulty are unaddressed.

steps.name: Distill Repair via low-cost falsification pilot
stop_conditions: Block if the pilot cannot be specified at fixture scale.
Flag and record as assessment failure if the pilot shows no interior minimum on the toy corpus.

steps.name: Invoke Plan the non-executed experiment
stop_conditions: Block if the plan implies running the experiment instead of handing it to experiment-harness.
Flag if the plan lacks a pre-registered prediction or stop rule.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Block if RESULT.md is synthesized from the route instead of the stage artifacts.
Flag if any open residue lacks an owner or next route.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The design stage is a tournament across three candidate entropy proxies, each needing independent metric/estimator/cost/prediction design to avoid one proxy's framing dominating the comparison.
subagent_strategy.explanation: One designer per proxy keeps the semantic-entropy, MDL, and residue-rate framings independent so the pareto comparison is fair, and a pilot reviewer keeps the falsification honest.
context: The measurable axis is contested; the prior search marked L-scu and L-info promote-residue with a rate-distortion alternative.
A single author would likely collapse the three proxies toward whichever is easiest to instrument.

roles.purpose: Design the self-consistency / semantic-entropy dispersion proxy and its predicted U-curve.
Design the two-part description-length (MDL) proxy and its interior minimizer.
Design the post-hoc residue / validation-failure-rate proxy and its regression on unit size.
Specify and adversarially review the low-cost pilot so a no-interior-minimum result is recorded as a real falsification.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the SCU entropy experiment refine loop with three parallel proxy designers (semantic-entropy, MDL, residue-rate) and a falsification-pilot reviewer, returning ranked design receipts only?
receipt_requirements: proxy metric, estimator, cost, and predicted U-curve

agents.residue: Key finding: Proxy A is monotone decreasing (left arm only), not U-shaped.
U is free by construction; content is r* invariance across reference models/serializations.
Measures realized E_energy trace, not pressure; cheapest; survivorship risk needs repair-budget lock.
Design falsifiable only after demoting B's U to zero-information and capping Proxy C repair budget.

boundaries.contract: The winning proxy design is a candidate until the falsification pilot supports a pre-registerable prediction.
The plan is a non-executed experiment handoff; running it and reporting results is owned by experiment-harness, not this refine loop.

state_namespaces.write_policy: This refine run may write only inside its own run folder.
No writes to the Craft definition from this run; experiment results route through a separate owner-approved task.

promotion_splits.source: refine experiment design and pilot evidence
promotion_splits.target: canonical Craft definition or Arcanum glossary
promotion_splits.rule: requires owner review and a separate promotion route

gates.condition: Each runtime-backed stage must name an available native capability handle before execution, or block with the missing handle.
Each runtime-backed stage must record a stage receipt artifact path or an explicit blocked reason before it is marked complete.
Any external research pass requires explicit operator confirmation under research-if-gap-appears.
Recommended proxy-designer and pilot-reviewer subagents require explicit operator approval before delegated execution.

The experiment must define a measurable entropy axis, an independent unit-size variable, a pre-registered U-curve prediction, and a condition under which the SCU-minimum hypothesis would be falsified.
Stages may propose candidate readings but must not edit the Craft definition or promote canonical Arcanum glossary, ontology, sigil, or spell knowledge.
RESULT.md must be synthesized from stage artifacts and the falsification pilot, not from the route artifact.

promotion_guardrails: Do not run the live experiment inside this refine loop; produce a non-executed plan and an experiment-harness handoff.
Do not edit CRAFT-INITIAL-DEFINITION.md from this run; experiment evidence routes through a separate owner-approved task.
Do not pre-register a prediction that cannot fail; an unfalsifiable design is a block, not a pass.
Do not collapse the three entropy proxies before the pareto comparison is recorded.
Do not execute proxy-designer or pilot-reviewer subagents without explicit operator approval.
